purpose: Distinguish original installed launcher and embedded-updater start/stop timing from point process counts during the separately bounded normal launch plan.
mechanism: Built-in local Register-CimIndicationEvent, transient session event queue, no Action and no permanent WMI consumer
prerequisites: Read actual current admin-role Boolean; no identity output
Use normal preinstalled Microsoft PowerShell administrator session if required; no privilege/ACL/security-policy changes
Verify no source-identifier collision and observe actual subscription receipts
Do not treat a missing/failed subscription or a point count as complete lifecycle coverage
cleanup: Unregister only molistart108 and molistop108 from the same session

sources.support: Transient local subscription, source identifier and queue behavior; process-start example requires administrator.
Start event fields and UTC FILETIME timestamps.
Stop event fields including read-only uint32 ExitStatus.
